youtube.title: The US Military's Secret Plan to Attack America | Operation Northwoods
youtube.description:
In 1962, America's top general signed a plan to fake terror attacks on US soil, as a pretext to invade Cuba. The memo is real. President Kennedy rejected it, and it stayed secret until 1997.

📂 Case File #001: Operation Northwoods

Sources:
• Joint Chiefs of Staff memorandum to the Secretary of Defense, "Justification for US Military Intervention in Cuba," 13 March 1962. Scan: National Security Archive, https://nsarchive2.gwu.edu/news/20010430/northwoods.pdf
• Released by the JFK Assassination Records Review Board, 1997.
Photos: U.S. Army (Gen. Lemnitzer) and the official White House portrait of JFK, public domain via Wikimedia Commons.
Narration voice: AI.
